metadata.description: A collection of AI coding assistant plugins

plugins.name: go-report-card
plugins.description: Go quality checks — tests, vulnerability scan, cyclomatic complexity, and formatting

plugins.name: godot
plugins.description: Godot 4.6 skills — CLI build verification, headless validation, one-shot animation patterns for AnimationTree state machines

plugins.name: github-pm
plugins.description: GitHub project management skills — create well-structured issues with acceptance criteria and scope a project into milestones using the GitHub CLI

plugins.name: dependabot
plugins.description: Dependabot configuration skills — group dependencies that must be upgraded together into a single PR and cut down Dependabot PR noise

plugins.name: dev-container
plugins.description: Dev container skills — wrap the development environment in a dev container, run Claude Code inside it, and persist authentication across rebuilds

plugins.name: sandbox
plugins.description: Claude Code isolation skills — choose and apply a sandboxing posture for a repository, configure the built-in Bash sandbox, write permission rules, and wrap the whole process with the sandbox runtime
